title: Normalized reduction of finite free coproducts
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme X, let B be the completed coefficient ring sheaf and k its first quotient. Put P=free_B(ULift(Fin r)) and S=free_k(ULift(Fin r)), for any natural rank r. Suppose q:P\to Res S restricts on each standard generator to the rank-one coefficient projection followed by the corresponding residue generator. For any integer b and any comparison c:DerivedExtension(single_b P)\to single_b S whose derived adjoint is single_b(q) followed by the inverse restriction/single comparison, c is an isomorphism and q is epic. Rank zero is included. [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction] [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]

proof.text: Scalar extension preserves the coproduct of unit modules. The normalized unit calculation on every generator constructs an ordinary extension isomorphism whose adjoint is precisely q.

proof.text: Restriction preserves coproducts, so q is a coproduct of epic rank-one coefficient projections followed by a coproduct comparison isomorphism. Finite free modules are flat; their single complexes are bounded above and K-flat.

theorem completed_free_coproduct_reduction (r : ℕ)
    (q : (completedCoproductIntegralFree l E X r) ⟶
      (scalarReductionRestriction.{u, u} l E X 0).obj
      (completedCoproductResidueFree l E X r))
    (hq : ∀ i : ULift.{u + 1} (Fin r), SheafOfModules.ιFree i ≫ q =
      CompletedCoefficientFree.quotientProjection.{u, u} l E X 0 ≫
        (scalarReductionRestriction.{u, u} l E X 0).map (SheafOfModules.ιFree i)) (b : ℤ)
    (cmp : (scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E X 0).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X) b).obj
        (completedCoproductIntegralFree l E X r)) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (scalarReductionTarget.{u, u} l E X 0) b).obj
        (completedCoproductResidueFree l E X r))
    (hcmp : (derivedScalarExtensionRestrictionAdjunction.{u, u} l E X 0).choose.unit.app
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X) b).obj
        (completedCoproductIntegralFree l E X r)) ≫
      (scalarReductionRestriction.{u, u} l E X 0).mapDerivedCategory.map cmp =
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X) b).map q ≫
        ((scalarReductionRestriction.{u, u} l E X 0).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor b).inv.app
          (completedCoproductResidueFree l E X r)) :
    IsIso cmp ∧ Epi q
